associations.rationale: The type directly states that the antiperiodic module is indecomposable over the periodic-function algebra.
The type directly states that the periodic-function algebra, viewed as its own module, is indecomposable.
The empty linear-equivalence type directly states that the periodic module is not isomorphic to the antiperiodic module.
The inhabited linear-equivalence type directly states that two copies of the periodic module are isomorphic to two copies of the antiperiodic module.
